Question B-006-010-011.

Why the correct answer is right: Radials at the base provide an RF return system and reduce ground losses.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "Install a wire ground system (radials) at the antenna base": Correct. Radials at the base provide an RF return system and reduce ground losses.
- sourceIndex 1: "Use an insulator with a higher breakdown voltage": A radial ground system reduces earth return losses at a ground-mounted vertical.
- sourceIndex 2: "Improve the impedance match at the base": A radial ground system reduces earth return losses at a ground-mounted vertical.
- sourceIndex 3: "Raise the antenna one eighth of a wavelength": A radial ground system reduces earth return losses at a ground-mounted vertical.
